grammar_focus: be going to + 动词原形(表打算/计划的将来,可替代 will/shall,KS12)主考——is/are/am going to、疑问否定、条件句结果部分用 will 不用 going to + will 表将来 / 将来进行时 will be doing(he will be watching)+ intend to do / 倒装 Among them will be…(辅考·课文①类)
scene: 黛比·哈特准备明天横渡英吉利海峡。她打算早上5点从法国海岸出发。黛比只有11岁,希望创一项新的世界纪录。她是个游泳能手,很多人认为她一定能成功。黛比的父亲将乘一条小船同她一道出发;哈特先生训练女儿已经多年,明天他将焦急地注视着女儿游过这段漫长的距离到达英国。黛比计划每两小时休息一下,只喝饮料、不吃固体食物。黛比的大部分同学将在英国海岸等候她;他们当中还会有黛比的母亲——她本人还是个姑娘时,也曾横渡过英吉利海峡!

grammar_card.title: be going to:打算做的将来
grammar_card.intro: be going to + 动词原形,表示打算、计划要做的事,常可替代 will / shall。be 随主语变:I am / he·she·it is / you·we·they are going to。全用本课和 Key structure 的句子举例。

rows: I am going to travel by air.
She is going to swim across the Channel.
They are going to move to a new house.
will 表将来(预测 / 自然会)
She will have something to drink.
将来进行时 will be + doing
He will be watching her anxiously.

specialRules.rule: 条件句结果部分用 will,不用 going to:You will enjoy yourself if you travel by sea.
intend to do / mean to do = 打算做(≈ be going to);倒装:Among them will be Debbie's mother = Debbie's mother will be among them.

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What is Debbie going to try to do?
options: Sail a boat across the sea

passage: Debbie Hart is going to swim across the English Channel tomorrow. She is going to set out from the French coast at five o'clock in the morning. Debbie is only eleven years old, and she hopes to set up a new world record. She is a strong swimmer, and many people feel that she is sure to succeed. Debbie's father will set out with her in a small boat. Mr. Hart has trained his daughter for years, and tomorrow he will be watching her anxiously as she swims the long distance to England. Debbie intends to take short rests every two hours. She will have something to drink, but she will not eat any solid food. Most of Debbie's school friends will be waiting for her on the English coast. Among them will be Debbie's mother, who swam the Channel herself when she was a girl.
